paragraphs.source_zh: 到达尼崎之后，秀吉故意没有向近在咫尺的中川和高山二将派遣使节，却向大和的筒井顺庆和丹后的细川藤孝派遣了密使。遣使的内容是，无论如何也要为信长报仇，诛杀逆贼明智光秀云云。

paragraphs.source_en: On the evening the army reached Amagasaki, great quantities of supplies began arriving one after another from Sakai and Osaka; from nearby Nagasu to Daimotsu Inlet, the whole area was crowded with columns of horses and fleets of boats. Everyone lit watchfires and made camp.

units.source_en: On the evening the army reached Amagasaki, great quantities of supplies began arriving one after another from Sakai and Osaka; from nearby Nagasu to Daimotsu Inlet, the whole area was crowded with columns of horses and fleets of boats.
units.source_zh: 部队到达尼崎的傍晚，从堺港和大坂就陆续运来大量的物资，附近的长洲到大物浦一带，挤满了马队和船队。

units.source_en: Everyone lit watchfires and made camp.
units.source_zh: 人们一齐点起篝火，开始野营。

paragraphs.source_zh: 部队到达尼崎的傍晚，从堺港和大坂就陆续运来大量的物资，附近的长洲到大物浦一带，挤满了马队和船队。人们一齐点起篝火，开始野营。

paragraphs.source_en: “Now it will be hard to tell who will win.” Astonished by the spectacle, farmers and townspeople began whispering among themselves.

units.source_en: “Now it will be hard to tell who will win.”

ja.t: つかわからなくなったな」

units.source_zh: “这一下，就难分胜负了。”

units.source_en: Astonished by the spectacle, farmers and townspeople began whispering among themselves.
units.source_zh: 农民和市民们为这样的阵势震惊，开始悄悄地议论。

paragraphs.source_zh: “这一下，就难分胜负了。”农民和市民们为这样的阵势震惊，开始悄悄地议论。

paragraphs.source_en: After nightfall, boats laden with firewood and rice continued to arrive without cease, while towering heaps of watchfires presented an astounding sight.

units.source_en: After nightfall, boats laden with firewood and rice continued to arrive without cease, while towering heaps of watchfires presented an astounding sight.
units.source_zh: 入夜，柴船和米船仍络绎不绝，一堆堆冲天的篝火令人叹为观止。

paragraphs.source_zh: 入夜，柴船和米船仍络绎不绝，一堆堆冲天的篝火令人叹为观止。

paragraphs.source_en: After shaving his head, Hideyoshi deliberately walked among the many watchfires so that his warriors might see him, then went to Seikenji Temple to meet his adopted son Hidekatsu. Hidekatsu was Nobunaga’s fourth son and had also followed from Himeji as one of the commanders.

units.source_en: After shaving his head, Hideyoshi deliberately walked among the many watchfires so that his warriors might see him, then went to Seikenji Temple to meet his adopted son Hidekatsu.
units.source_zh: 秀吉剃完头，为了向将士们显示一下，故意穿过一堆堆篝火，去栖贤寺见养子秀胜。

units.source_en: Hidekatsu was Nobunaga’s fourth son and had also followed from Himeji as one of the commanders.
units.source_zh: 秀胜是信长四子，作为一员大将，也从姬路跟来了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉剃完头，为了向将士们显示一下，故意穿过一堆堆篝火，去栖贤寺见养子秀胜。秀胜是信长四子，作为一员大将，也从姬路跟来了。

paragraphs.source_en: “Hidekatsu, I have something to tell you. Have someone summon Hori Kyūtarō as well.” Hideyoshi gave the instruction with solemn gravity.

units.source_en: “Hidekatsu, I have something to tell you. Have someone summon Hori Kyūtarō as well.”
units.source_zh: “秀胜，我有话要说，让人把堀久太郎也叫来。”

units.source_en: Hideyoshi gave the instruction with solemn gravity.
units.source_zh: 秀吉郑重地嘱道。

paragraphs.source_zh: “秀胜，我有话要说，让人把堀久太郎也叫来。”秀吉郑重地嘱道。

paragraphs.source_en: Seeing that his adoptive father’s head had become as smooth and bare as a monk’s, Hidekatsu started, then hastily straightened his posture. “Father, what have you…”

units.source_en: Seeing that his adoptive father’s head had become as smooth and bare as a monk’s, Hidekatsu started, then hastily straightened his posture.
units.source_zh: 秀胜看见养父的头成了一个光溜溜的和尚头，不禁一怔，连忙正襟危坐。

units.source_en: “Father, what have you…”
units.source_zh: “父亲，您这是……”

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀胜看见养父的头成了一个光溜溜的和尚头，不禁一怔，连忙正襟危坐。“父亲，您这是……”

paragraphs.source_en: “It is only fitting for a retainer. I did not shave it before because preparations for the decisive battle were not yet complete. Now they are. I shall speak to you shortly; first let us wait for Kyūtarō.” Hideyoshi no longer used any honorific at all for Hori Hidemasa, once a close attendant of Nobunaga.

units.source_en: “It is only fitting for a retainer.
units.source_zh: “作为家臣理当如此。

units.source_en: I did not shave it before because preparations for the decisive battle were not yet complete.

ja.t: っていなかったからだ。

units.source_zh: 从前没有剃掉，是因为决战的准备还没有做好。

units.source_en: Now they are.
units.source_zh: 现在准备已经就绪了。

units.source_en: I shall speak to you shortly; first let us wait for Kyūtarō.”
units.source_zh: 待会儿我有话要说，先等一下久太郎。”

units.source_en: Hideyoshi no longer used any honorific at all for Hori Hidemasa, once a close attendant of Nobunaga.
units.source_zh: 对信长先前近臣堀秀政，秀吉已经完全不用敬称了。

paragraphs.source_zh: “作为家臣理当如此。从前没有剃掉，是因为决战的准备还没有做好。现在准备已经就绪了。待会儿我有话要说，先等一下久太郎。”对信长先前近臣堀秀政，秀吉已经完全不用敬称了。

paragraphs.source_en: Hidekatsu went out to receive Hori Kyūtarō, while Hideyoshi summoned Ōmura Yūko, who was waiting in the outer room. “Yūko, remain in the outer room and record everything that happens tonight.”

units.source_en: Hidekatsu went out to receive Hori Kyūtarō, while Hideyoshi summoned Ōmura Yūko, who was waiting in the outer room.
units.source_zh: 秀胜出去迎接堀久太郎，秀吉把在外间待命的大村幽古叫了进来。

units.source_en: “Yūko, remain in the outer room and record everything that happens tonight.”
units.source_zh: “幽古，你在外间把今晚的事情都记录下来。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀胜出去迎接堀久太郎，秀吉把在外间待命的大村幽古叫了进来。“幽古，你在外间把今晚的事情都记录下来。”

paragraphs.source_en: Though facing a savage battle that would determine the course of the realm, he still possessed the leisure and elegance to keep a chronicler beside him and have his own deeds portrayed. Other than Hideyoshi, there was perhaps no second man in the realm capable of such a magnificent gesture. In that sense, he regarded himself as the embodiment of truth; in his pride, he saw himself as the sun.

units.source_en: Though facing a savage battle that would determine the course of the realm, he still possessed the leisure and elegance to keep a chronicler beside him and have his own deeds portrayed.
units.source_zh: 他面临决定天下大势的恶战，却仍然富有闲情逸致，让读手在身边演绎自己。

units.source_en: Other than Hideyoshi, there was perhaps no second man in the realm capable of such a magnificent gesture.
units.source_zh: 能做出这种壮举的人，除去秀吉，天下恐再无第二人。

units.source_en: In that sense, he regarded himself as the embodiment of truth; in his pride, he saw himself as the sun.
units.source_zh: 在这个意义上，他把自己奉为真理，他自负，以太阳自居。

paragraphs.source_zh: 他面临决定天下大势的恶战，却仍然富有闲情逸致，让读手在身边演绎自己。能做出这种壮举的人，除去秀吉，天下恐再无第二人。在这个意义上，他把自己奉为真理，他自负，以太阳自居。

paragraphs.source_en: Yūko withdrew, and when Hidekatsu and Hori Kyūtarō entered, they almost brushed past him.

units.source_en: Yūko withdrew, and when Hidekatsu and Hori Kyūtarō entered, they almost brushed past him.
units.source_zh: 幽古退了出去，秀胜和堀久太郎进来时，几与幽古擦肩而过。

paragraphs.source_zh: 幽古退了出去，秀胜和堀久太郎进来时，几与幽古擦肩而过。

paragraphs.source_en: “Kyūtarō, you listen carefully as well.”

units.source_en: “Kyūtarō, you listen carefully as well.”
units.source_zh: “久太郎，你也好好地听一下。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “久太郎，你也好好地听一下。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes, my lord.”

units.source_en: “Yes, my lord.”

paragraphs.source_en: “You are my son, and you also bear our lord’s blood. To you, the traitor Mitsuhide is the enemy who killed your natural father; to me, your adoptive father, he is the enemy of my lord.”

units.source_en: “You are my son, and you also bear our lord’s blood.
units.source_zh: “你是我的儿子，又是主公的血脉。

units.source_en: To you, the traitor Mitsuhide is the enemy who killed your natural father;
units.source_zh: 光秀这个逆贼，对于你，是你生父的仇人；

units.source_en: to me, your adoptive father, he is the enemy of my lord.”
units.source_zh: 对于养父我来说，是主公的仇人。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你是我的儿子，又是主公的血脉。光秀这个逆贼，对于你，是你生父的仇人；对于养父我来说，是主公的仇人。”

paragraphs.source_en: “You speak truly, Father.”

units.source_en: “You speak truly, Father.”

ja.t: のおっしゃるとおりです」

units.source_zh: “父亲说得不错。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “父亲说得不错。”

paragraphs.source_en: “You must charge forward without fear! You must prove yourself worthy to be the son of Lord Ufu and the adopted son of the Lord of Chikuzen. Do not cling to the splendor of this life; become an exemplar to generations yet unborn.”

units.source_en: “You must charge forward without fear!
units.source_zh: “你定要勇往直前！

units.source_en: You must prove yourself worthy to be the son of Lord Ufu and the adopted son of the Lord of Chikuzen.
units.source_zh: 你要无愧于右府之子、筑前守养子的身份。

units.source_en: Do not cling to the splendor of this life; become an exemplar to generations yet unborn.”
units.source_zh: 不要留恋今生荣华，要成为后世之表率。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你定要勇往直前！你要无愧于右府之子、筑前守养子的身份。不要留恋今生荣华，要成为后世之表率。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes, Father!”

units.source_en: “Yes, Father!”

paragraphs.source_en: “Hidekatsu shall engrave Father’s teaching upon his heart and avenge this wrong without fail.” So roused by his adoptive father, Hidekatsu felt his blood surge and flexed his hands, eager for action.

units.source_en: “Hidekatsu shall engrave Father’s teaching upon his heart and avenge this wrong without fail.”
units.source_zh: “父亲的教导，秀胜谨记在心，定要报仇雪恨。”

units.source_en: So roused by his adoptive father, Hidekatsu felt his blood surge and flexed his hands, eager for action.
units.source_zh: 秀胜被养父如此一鼓舞，不禁热血沸腾，摩拳擦掌。

paragraphs.source_zh: “父亲的教导，秀胜谨记在心，定要报仇雪恨。”秀胜被养父如此一鼓舞，不禁热血沸腾，摩拳擦掌。

paragraphs.source_en: Behind Hideyoshi’s words lay another purpose: to settle who should serve as supreme commander in this campaign. With this speech, he intended to settle the matter once and for all. Nobutaka or Nobukatsu? Shibata or Hashiba? If they began arguing among themselves, not only would the opportunity for battle be lost, but even those opportunistic daimyō might be driven into Mitsuhide’s camp. Now the crux of the matter was Nobutaka’s attitude in Osaka.

units.source_en: Behind Hideyoshi’s words lay another purpose: to settle who should serve as supreme commander in this campaign.
units.source_zh: 秀吉这番话的背后，还有一个意图——这次战役究竟谁应做总大将。

units.source_en: With this speech, he intended to settle the matter once and for all.

ja.t: をつけようとしていた。

units.source_zh: 他想通过这番话一锤定音。

units.source_en: Nobutaka or Nobukatsu? Shibata or Hashiba?
units.source_zh: 是信孝还是信雄，柴田还是羽柴？

units.source_en: If they began arguing among themselves, not only would the opportunity for battle be lost, but even those opportunistic daimyō might be driven into Mitsuhide’s camp.

ja.t: いやることにもなりかねない。

units.source_zh: 一旦几个人争论起来，不仅贻误战机，甚至会把那些见风使舵的大名赶到光秀的阵营里去。

units.source_en: Now the crux of the matter was Nobutaka’s attitude in Osaka.
units.source_zh: 现在，问题的关键，就在大坂信孝的态度了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉这番话的背后，还有一个意图——这次战役究竟谁应做总大将。他想通过这番话一锤定音。是信孝还是信雄，柴田还是羽柴？一旦几个人争论起来，不仅贻误战机，甚至会把那些见风使舵的大名赶到光秀的阵营里去。现在，问题的关键，就在大坂信孝的态度了。

paragraphs.source_en: If Nobutaka clung to some trifling question of rank and demanded that Hideyoshi come pay his respects, precious time would be wasted, and the entire situation might even turn against them.

units.source_en: If Nobutaka clung to some trifling question of rank and demanded that Hideyoshi come pay his respects, precious time would be wasted, and the entire situation might even turn against them.
units.source_zh: 如果信孝拘泥于无足轻重的名分，提出让秀吉到自己那里问安之类的要求，就会白白地浪费时间，甚至可能导致全局被动。

paragraphs.source_zh: 如果信孝拘泥于无足轻重的名分，提出让秀吉到自己那里问安之类的要求，就会白白地浪费时间，甚至可能导致全局被动。

paragraphs.source_en: “Tomorrow…”

units.source_en: “Tomorrow…”

paragraphs.source_en: “Therefore, now that you understand the resolve shared by father and son, I want you, Kyūtarō, to inform Osaka. I expect I shall not have a single moment to spare tomorrow.”

units.source_en: “Therefore, now that you understand the resolve shared by father and son, I want you, Kyūtarō, to inform Osaka.
units.source_zh: “因此，在了解我们父子的决心之后，我想请久太郎通告大坂。

units.source_en: I expect I shall not have a single moment to spare tomorrow.”
units.source_zh: 估计我明天丝毫空闲都没有。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “因此，在了解我们父子的决心之后，我想请久太郎通告大坂。估计我明天丝毫空闲都没有。”

paragraphs.source_en: “As you command.” Once again, Hidemasa felt that this was like some feat of magic. Yet, strangely enough, fully aware of the importance of his orders, he immediately began making preparations.

units.source_en: “As you command.”
units.source_zh: “遵命。”

units.source_en: Once again, Hidemasa felt that this was like some feat of magic.
units.source_zh: 秀政又觉得这像是魔术一样。

units.source_en: Yet, strangely enough, fully aware of the importance of his orders, he immediately began making preparations.
units.source_zh: 但是，他深知被吩咐的事情之重要，立刻就去着手准备了，真是奇怪。

paragraphs.source_zh: “遵命。”秀政又觉得这像是魔术一样。但是，他深知被吩咐的事情之重要，立刻就去着手准备了，真是奇怪。

paragraphs.source_en: From that moment, both Hideyoshi and Kanbei devoted themselves wholly to preparations for battle; yet amid such extreme tension, the two somehow stole moments from their labors to amuse themselves—a truly astonishing thing. That night they did not sleep at all, but continued discussing tactics amid laughter and conversation.

units.source_en: From that moment, both Hideyoshi and Kanbei devoted themselves wholly to preparations for battle; yet amid such extreme tension, the two somehow stole moments from their labors to amuse themselves—a truly astonishing thing.
units.source_zh: 从这时起，无论是秀吉还是官兵卫，都已全身心投入到作战的准备中去了，在这种高度紧张的时候，二人竟然忙里偷闲，找起乐子来，真是不可思议。

units.source_en: That night they did not sleep at all, but continued discussing tactics amid laughter and conversation.
units.source_zh: 当日夜，二人彻夜未眠，一边谈笑，一边继续研究战术。

paragraphs.source_zh: 从这时起，无论是秀吉还是官兵卫，都已全身心投入到作战的准备中去了，在这种高度紧张的时候，二人竟然忙里偷闲，找起乐子来，真是不可思议。当日夜，二人彻夜未眠，一边谈笑，一边继续研究战术。

paragraphs.source_en: Dawn came: it was the twelfth day of the sixth month.

units.source_en: Dawn came: it was the twelfth day of the sixth month.
units.source_zh: 天亮，是为六月十二日。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天亮，是为六月十二日。

paragraphs.source_en: Every one of Hideyoshi’s predictions came true with almost unbelievable precision. This was indeed the day that would determine the course of the realm.

units.source_en: Every one of Hideyoshi’s predictions came true with almost unbelievable precision.

units.source_zh: 秀吉的预言全都令人难以置信地应验。

units.source_en: This was indeed the day that would determine the course of the realm.
units.source_zh: 此日果是决定天下大势的一日。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀吉的预言全都令人难以置信地应验。此日果是决定天下大势的一日。

paragraphs.source_en: At first light, the first man to reach headquarters was a secret messenger from Tsutsui Junkei. Though the confidential letter did not expressly promise the immediate dispatch of troops, it stated clearly that Junkei would die before joining Mitsuhide’s cause.

units.source_en: At first light, the first man to reach headquarters was a secret messenger from Tsutsui Junkei. Though the confidential letter did not expressly promise the immediate dispatch of troops, it stated clearly that Junkei would die before joining Mitsuhide’s cause.
units.source_zh: 天刚一亮，最先赶到中军帐来的是筒井顺庆的密使，虽然密信上没有写明立刻派兵，但是已经明确表示，誓死不与光秀同流合污。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天刚一亮，最先赶到中军帐来的是筒井顺庆的密使，虽然密信上没有写明立刻派兵，但是已经明确表示，誓死不与光秀同流合污。

paragraphs.source_en: Next, Ikeda Nobuteru arrived from Tango at the head of five thousand soldiers. While Hideyoshi was conferring with Nobuteru, Matsui Yasuyuki, a senior retainer of Hosokawa Fujitaka and his son, also arrived at Hideyoshi’s headquarters as their envoy.

units.source_en: Next, Ikeda Nobuteru arrived from Tango at the head of five thousand soldiers.
units.source_zh: 接着，池田信辉率领五千士兵从丹后赶来。

units.source_en: While Hideyoshi was conferring with Nobuteru, Matsui Yasuyuki, a senior retainer of Hosokawa Fujitaka and his son, also arrived at Hideyoshi’s headquarters as their envoy.

paragraphs.source_zh: 接着，池田信辉率领五千士兵从丹后赶来。正在和信辉会谈，细川藤孝父子的重臣松井康之，也作为使者来到了秀吉的大帐。

paragraphs.source_en: “Oh, Hosokawa’s envoy has arrived…” Hideyoshi thrust out his chest proudly before Nobuteru.

units.source_en: “Oh, Hosokawa’s envoy has arrived…” Hideyoshi thrust out his chest proudly before Nobuteru.
units.source_zh: “哦，细川的使者到了……”秀吉在信辉面前高高地挺起胸脯。
